title: WolOS Hub index, format 1 (extended)
description: ADR 0047. Today's plugin index (format 1: format, serial, expires, plugins[]) keeps its fields and meaning; everything below is added. The 0.12 reader ignores unknown keys and drops an entry that breaks its own rules, so a hub index parses there unchanged. Times are Unix seconds. index.json.sig is the legacy Ed25519 signature over the same bytes, index.json.wsig the hybrid one (label wolos/index/1).

serial.description: Grows with every publication; a lower serial never replaces a higher one.

expires.description: issued + 7 days; re-signed at least daily.

generated.description: When the Worker built the export this index comes from.

intermediates.description: Intermediate certificates (.wolcert objects, ADR 0046) newer than the image's trust store.

revoked.description: Where the revocation list of this publication is, and which one it is.

picture.description: A listing picture by its CDN file name <sha256>.<png|webp>: https://cdn.wolos.org/plugins/pictures/<file>, served as image/png or image/webp.

assetUrl.description: A GitHub release asset: artefacts are never hosted by WolOS.

description.description: The package's own description (hubcheck facts, through the Worker's export): plain text, tabs and line breaks allowed; no other C0 or C1 control (as the readers' char::is_control). Left out when the package has none.

icon.description: The listing's icon: the file name <sha256>.<png|webp> of the picture (the extension from its type), served at https://cdn.wolos.org/plugins/pictures/<file> (PNG or WebP, at most 2 MiB and 4096 px a side, checked by the hub against the package). Only a picture uploaded with this publication is named.

screenshots.description: Up to 8 screenshots in the package's order, as icon: file names <sha256>.<png|webp> of pictures on the CDN under plugins/pictures/.

sha256.description: Of the release asset, pinned at the first check. A different file at the same URL is refused.

trust.description: trusted: signed with a trusted certificate (an admin approved the developer or organisation); origin: signed with an origin certificate (who made it and from which repository, issued once the CLA is accepted), or with a trusted one that was revoked as superseded; community: no certificate the hub counts.

cert.description: Id of the leaf certificate (SHA-512 over its keys, 128 hex; 16 hex for a certificate of before that rule) that signed the file (trust wolos, trusted or origin), from hubcheck's report through the Worker's export.

verdict.description: block and not-checked releases are never listed.

withdrawn.description: This version was withdrawn by the hub: its release statement is on the revocation list (reason withdrawn-version). Shown, never installed; the author's certificate is untouched.

statement.description: The signed release statement of this version (label wolos/release/1, by the Index intermediate).

kinds.description: Plugins only; today's field, read by 0.12. From the plugin.toml sections, through the Worker's export.

permissions.description: Plugins only (an extension.toml has none); today's field, shown before Install. From plugin.toml, through the Worker's export.

min_wolos.description: From the manifest, through the Worker's export; a signed file needs 0.13.

host.description: Extensions only: the app id it extends.
